name: Fastfetch
description: Display Debian system summary, OS version, kernel, uptime, packages, and ASCII art logo
check_cmd: export PATH=$PATH:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/games; which fastfetch || dpkg-query -W -f='${Status}' fastfetch 2>/dev/null | grep -q 'installed'

commands.fastfetch_cmd: export PATH=$PATH:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/games; export TERM=xterm-256color; fastfetch --pipe false 2>&1 || fastfetch 2>&1
